These are the multiple benefits that can give the Ficus tree to the needfuls. This is used as multiple purposes plus it can be used as an ornamental plant. 
 
 
 Systemic Classification 
 
 Botanical Name – Ficus Carica 
 Family – Moraceae 
 Genus – Ficus 
 
 
 
 Other Vernacular Names 
 
 
 In Sanskrit – Phalgu, rajudumbar, anjeer 
 In Hindi – Anjeer 
 
 
 
 Habitat 
 This tree has been cultivated since ancient times, in deep and fresh soil and it grows wild in dry and sunny areas like rocky areas which are the height of 1700-1800 meters from sea level, it usually grows in porous and free draining soil and can also grow under the poor nutritional soil. This tree can be pollinated with fig wasp in colder areas. 
 This is a kind of large, dense, shade tree  7–10 m (23–33 ft) tall having smooth bark of white colour. 
 
 Leaves – fragrant, 12–25 cm (41⁄2–10 inches) long and 10–18 cm (4–7 inches) wide, and are deeply lobed (three or five lobes). 
 Fruits – tear-shaped, 1 to 2 inches long, its green in colour when unripened and is of purplish or brown in colour when ripened. It is sweet in taste and has soft flesh which has numerous crunchy seeds. 
 
 This is said to be the very first plant that has been cultivated by humans, this can be of different sizes, shapes according to its cultivated area and temperature. In India, it is found in Puna, in southern India it is found in Bellary, and in the districts of Anantapur, this herb is found widely. In Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, and Mysore it is found in less amounts. 
 
 
 Classical Categorization 
 
 Acharya Charak has categorised it in sutra sthana in twenty-seventh chapter, where he says this phalgu herb is used for tarpana (nourishment), brihamn (strengthening), guru (heavy to digest), and is of sheetalam (cold potency). 
 Acharya Sushrut has also categorised sutra sthana in the forty-sixth chapter with the same properties but added one or two like its Madhur (sweet) and vishtimbh in nature. 
 
 
 Ancient Verses 
 Shloka – 1 
 तर्पणं बृहणं फल्गु गुरु विष्टंभि शीतलं। 
 Reference – Charak Samhita Sutra Sthana 27 / 128 
 Interpretation of Shloka – This herb is used for tarpana (nourishment), brihamn (strengthening), guru (heavy to digest), vishtambhi and is of sheetalam (cold potency). 
 Shloka – 2 
 विष्टंभि मधुरं शीतं फल्गुजं तर्पणं गुरु। 
 Reference – Sushrut Samhita Sutra Sthana 28 / 8 
 Interpretation of Shloka – Acharya Sushrut has categorized this herb under the Phala Varga, consisting of vishtambhan gunna, Madhur (sweet), tarpana gunna (nourishment), and heavy in properties. 
 Shloka – 3 
 अन्जीरं शीतलं स्वादु गुरु पित्तास्रवातजित्। 
 Reference – Madhav Nidan 
 Interpretation of Shloka – anjeer herb is sweet, cold and good for pittaj, raktaj, and vata disorders. Due to these properties, it helps to combat various diseases. 
 
 
 Ayurvedic Properties 
 
 Rasa (Taste) – Madhur (Sweet) 
 Guna (Quality) – Guru (Heavy), Snigadh (Moist) 
 Veerya (Potency) – Sheeta (Cold) 
 Vipaka (Post digestive effect) – Madhur (Sweet) 
 Karma (Action) – Balances the Vata pitta dosha due to its Madhur and Sheeta guna 
 Projyang (Part used) – Fruits are used 
 
 
 
 Effects On Doshas 
 
 It helps to balance the Vata pitta dosha due to its Madhur and Sheeta guna. 
 This helps to demolish the inflammation signs. 
 This is good for moisturising the body and is helpful in maintaining the flow of doshas. 
 This herb is very effective in hepato protection and maintains the spleen’s health also. 
 This herb is used for the purification of blood and acts on pitta dosha. 
 Due to its snigdha Guna this herb is Kapha nihsarak in nature. 
 This herb helps in diuretics and is an aphrodisiac in nature and also works as a laxative. 
 
 
 Practical Uses 
 
 You can apply the hot paste of fruit to the inflammatory signs. 
 It is helpful in subsiding the dryness and maintains the flow of doshas that lies in the abdomen so that’s why acting on constipation. 
 Its fruits are used to clear the shwas vaha srotas with their roughness and burning in the chest region can be subsided with the help of this herb. 
 This is also used in fever and weakness in the body. 
 It is also used in calculus, renal colic, and deprivation of urinary symptoms. 
 On various skin diseases, like burning over the skin, measles type condition can be cured too by the application of paste of its fruits on the affected area. 
 
 
 
 Dosage 
 2-3 fruits are capable of reducing the effect of various conditions.
